title: Classify RR* and classical pulsating SIMBAD types in check_known_variable
what_happened: In All-Sky Galactic Halo Batch 2 (live-allsky-halo-b2-out), horizontal-branch RR Lyrae variable Gaia DR3 6164530246002222208 (SIMBAD RR*, M_G=0.50, Teff=6439 K, [Fe/H]=-0.88, RV scatter=53.6 km/s) landed at Tier B because check_known_variable only checked {EB*, LPV*, Mira, CV*}.
generic_lesson: Include RR*, LP*, Cepheid, delta Scuti, SR*, and eclipsing/cataclysmic SIMBAD codes in check_known_variable so known pulsating variables are resolved as Explained.
